descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S26 「通过真实的 Post-Round 面板问 Ask：Save Edits 之后按改过的记录回答；打开另一个病人之后只按那个病人回答」 Ask through the real Post-Round sheet: after Save Edits it answers from the edited note; after opening another patient it answers from that patient only

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi …（TFA-92593 AC 2；TFA-92593 AC 3；TFA-92593 AC 6；TFA-92593 AC 9；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-17）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Two Hospital patients under one physician, both note-ready: A with note N-H, B with a CHF note (furosemide, echo)

When A: Edit Note, add 'QA-ASK-EDIT start metoprolol 12.5 mg PO BID', Save Edits, open 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient', tap the preset 'What's in the plan section?' (cp1). Open B without reloading, open Ask, the same preset (cp2). Back on A: Encounter tab, Ask, type 'What's in the plan section?' (cp3)

Then A's Post-Round answer includes metoprolol (the saved edit). B's answer includes furosemide and the echo and nothing from A (no ceftriaxone, no metoprolol, not A's name). A's Encounter-tab answer is recorded beside the Post-Round one

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint, scoped to the Ask dialog (RG-SCOPE): the note behind the sheet holds the same words, so a page-wide mustContain would pass without the answer. The negatives on cp2 also hold page-wide. reqs [T10] (TFA-92593 AC 3, ready for qa) is ungated, so stale context reports as Fail. cp3 is recorded and judged against U2 once Q4 is answered

在哪跑：dev 单元 U32；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
